  PROBLEM: The five pinned SHA-256 digests for divergent consumer-variant commands are hardcoded constants that will fail CI if any of those five files changes by even one byte, without a mechanism to distinguish an authorized change from an unauthorized one.
  WHY: If the workflow-templates/.claude/commands/analyze-log.md file on disk differs from the pinned digest, CI fails with "consumer-variant template changed; its pinned SHA-256 no longer matches: commands/analyze-log.md". The digest must be updated atomically in the same PR that changes the file — this is the intended design per the plan ("Updating TEMPLATE_DIVERGENCE is itself a protected-equivalent change"). No defect in the code; noted as a documentation of the intended contract.
